objective: Integrate the Treasury Wave 3 economic admission stack onto the current mainline without regressing current-main work, while preserving Overseer supremacy, ComputeRouter placement, Guardian capability authority, worker boundaries, and F07 evidence authority.

rulesConsidered: Treasury is subordinate to Overseer and is not a physical scheduler.
Economic admission precedes discretionary production consumption.
F07 remains the independent artifact truth boundary.
Compatibility mechanisms do not become a second production economic authority.
Current main changes must not be overwritten by an older branch snapshot.

notes: The merge construction uses existing repository trees and does not introduce new ambient worker authority.
Security state is not declared green until the current reconciliation's CI completes.

conflicts.originalConflict: Current main and the Treasury Wave 3 branch both modified RenderIntentContracts.ts and RenderFabric.ts after their merge base.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Use the Treasury head versions for those two files because they contain the complete Treasury Wave 1→3 contract evolution, while current-main-only provider-native MCP changes remain preserved in all other current-main tree paths.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: Three-way tree reconciliation took current main as the base tree, applied Treasury-only changes, and resolved the two overlapping Treasury contract/fabric files with the complete Treasury head versions.

verificationPlan: Require repository CI and current floor/governance/compute validations.
